question: _______ is an asset pledged by a borrower, to a lender as security for a loan.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Collateral.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Collateral** is an asset **pledged by a borrower** to secure a loan from a lender.
 
• It acts as a** guarantee** to the lender that the borrower will repay the loan.
